title: Measuring Affinity between Attention-Head Weight Subspaces via the Projection Kernel
abstract: arXiv:2601.10266v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Understanding relationships between attention heads is essential for interpreting the internal structure of Transformers, yet existing metrics do not capture this structure well. We focus on the subspaces spanned by attention-head weight matrices and quantify head-to-head relationships using the Projection Kernel (PK), a principal-angle-based measure of subspace similarity. Experiments on GPT2-small, BLOOM-560M, and Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct show that PK reproduces known head-to-head interactions on the IOI task more clearly than prior metrics such as the Composition Score. We further introduce a framework to quantify the informativeness of PK distributions by comparing them with a reference distribution derived from random orthogonal subspaces. As an application, we analyze a directed graph constructed from PK and show that, in GPT2-small, L4H7 acts as a hub by functioning as an Identity Head.

translated_title: 基于投影核测量注意力头权重子空间之间的亲和度
translated_abstract: 理解注意力头之间的关系对于解释Transformer的内部结构至关重要，然而现有的度量方法无法很好地捕捉这种结构。我们关注注意力头权重矩阵所张成的子空间，并使用投影核这一基于主角度的子空间相似性度量来量化头与头之间的关系。在GPT2-small、BLOOM-560M和Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct上的实验表明，投影核比诸如组合分数等先前指标更清晰地再现了IOI任务上已知的头对头交互。我们进一步引入了一个框架，通过将投影核分布与从随机正交子空间导出的参考分布进行比较，来量化投影核分布的信息量。作为一项应用，我们分析了由投影核构建的有向图，并表明在GPT2-small中，L4H7通过充当身份头而发挥了枢纽作用。
tldr: 本文提出用基于主角度的投影核度量注意力头权重子空间之间的亲和度，该指标比传统方法更清晰地揭示注意力头间的交互关系，并据此发现GPT2-small中的L4H7作为身份头充当信息枢纽。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Projection Kernel (PK), a principal-angle-based subspace similarity measure, to quantify affinity between attention-head weight subspaces, showing it captures known head-to-head interactions more clearly than prior metrics and revealing that L4H7 in GPT2-small acts as a hub through its role as an Identity Head.
